scope: All English and German grammar in the reviewed A1-C2 curriculum; initial 112 English and 144 German units are a migration baseline, not a ceiling.

statusDefinitions.implemented: Artifacts/code exist; required verification is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.verified: Ticket-specific acceptance evidence recorded; not a global effectiveness claim.
statusDefinitions.blocked: A concrete external or technical blocker is recorded.
statusDefinitions.deferred: Conditional work is deliberately postponed with a reason.

ownerNote: Roles are requirements, not assignments to named people. Human review and learner participation are not assumed completed or booked.

root.purpose: Workspace, runtime manifest and task evidence

core.purpose: Canonical shared contracts, evidence, scheduling and mirror sync

en_assessment.purpose: English upstream assessment contract and service

en_client.purpose: English assessment, audio and planning adapters

de_domain.purpose: German pure evaluation, mastery and scheduling

en_static.purpose: Active English Daily and Grammar runtime

de_static.purpose: Active German Daily and Grammar runtime

en_features.purpose: English state, Studio, progress and review

de_features.purpose: German state, Studio, progress and review

en_scripts.purpose: English generated curriculum, payload and installer

de_scripts.purpose: German generated curriculum, payload and installer

research.purpose: Existing CEFR research; separate from grammar feedback

docs.purpose: Strategy, reviewed scope, reports and protocols

phases.title: Establish the current baseline
phases.exit: Canonical routes and storage mapped; preservation fixtures and defect reproductions saved.

phases.title: Fix incorrect assessment and evidence
phases.exit: Known false-success, answer-exposure and verification-conflict cases cannot award independent credit.

phases.title: Build the shared evidence foundation
phases.exit: One versioned record and reducer serve both apps without losing historical data.

phases.title: Map the complete grammar scope
phases.exit: All current lessons and all 21 families mapped; every missing required cell creates work.

phases.title: Connect complete learning cycles
phases.exit: Representative speaking and writing cycles work on actual static and React routes.

phases.title: Make daily practice usable and personal
phases.exit: The learner can start, repair, resume and review with clear reasons and honest progress.

phases.title: Evaluate and integrate suitable model assistance
phases.exit: Task-specific benchmarks determine supported families; unsupported functions abstain.

phases.title: Complete all grammar families
phases.exit: Every required curriculum cell has reviewed content, an appropriate assessment path and verified learner-route evidence.

phases.title: Measure independent learner performance
phases.exit: Dated baseline, transfer and delayed outcomes reported separately by language and mode.

phases.title: Evaluate adaptive review scheduling
phases.exit: A prospective comparison supports activation or documents retention of the baseline.

phases.title: Verify each delivered increment
phases.exit: Exact build and installer receipts demonstrate functional routes and data preservation.

phases.title: Consider reinforcement learning only with sufficient evidence
phases.exit: A recorded decision either opens a bounded experiment or defers it without blocking the core product.

tasks.title: Map active routes and current runtime
tasks.progressNote: Captured source and installed versions, process paths, storage keys and active-route implementations. The restored source runtime passed all 10 HTTP probes, and eight selected post-change browser regressions passed. Launcher-target resolution and a verified pre-change browser baseline remain incomplete; post-change evidence does not retroactively close those B01 requirements.
tasks.deliverable: Dated route/storage/version map and English/German HTTP/browser baseline.
acceptance: Identify source, installed copy, launcher, web/API endpoints and the implementation behind each learner route.
Preserve the initial Git state; report current failures independently of earlier reports.
Do not expand this work into the thesis or unrelated sibling apps.

tasks.title: Prepare preservation and restore fixtures
tasks.progressNote: Implemented isolated desktop profile, extraction and staging-cache paths. Both isolated installer lifecycles passed with the synthetic file marker preserved. The reports explicitly mark browser-data restore as not run; full browser or IndexedDB export/restore, real legacy records, due reviews and playable-audio recovery remain pending.
tasks.deliverable: Local export fixtures covering attempts, due reviews, settings, drafts and playable audio.
acceptance: Include legacy, partial, duplicate and current records; use isolated profiles.
Record baseline counts, identifiers and audio hashes without exposing personal content in reports.
Demonstrate a recovery path before any schema migration.

tasks.title: Reproduce consequential defects
tasks.progressNote: Added reproductions and focused regressions for malformed English assessments, German language uncertainty, capitalization, accepted alternatives and the German weil evaluation bypass. Caller-verification conflicts also receive focused coverage, and all eight selected browser regressions passed. The complete ledger for answer exposure, offline completion and unsupported shared delay/novelty flags across all affected routes remains pending.
tasks.deliverable: Focused regression ledger with expected verdicts and route evidence.
acceptance: Cover malformed upstream data, language uncertainty, valid alternatives, answer exposure and offline completion.
Reproduce English verification conflicts and shared transfer/delay flags that lack actual evidence.
Record each failure before its fix; a non-reproduction requires revised evidence rather than automatic closure.

tasks.title: Validate English upstream assessments
tasks.progressNote: Provider and client validation reject malformed payloads, invalid edit spans, overlapping edits and inconsistent fields; the inspected caller boundary preserves unverified outcomes. Focused checks, selected browser regressions and the isolated English 27.3.22-to-27.3.23 installer lifecycle passed. B03 and comprehensive caller acceptance remain incomplete, so this ticket remains implemented rather than verified; no all-caller or full-curriculum qualification is claimed.
tasks.deliverable: Strict upstream validation and explicit unassessed results.
acceptance: A valid empty matches array is accepted; missing/null/non-array matches and invalid JSON are not.
Validate edit bounds, replacement types and overlapping edits; timeout never becomes a clean answer.
Malformed assessments cannot raise progress through any caller.

tasks.title: Fix German language and orthography handling
tasks.progressNote: Domain and static grading preserve capitalization and relevant punctuation, accept authored short-answer alternatives and leave inconclusive language unassessed with null accuracy. The Automaticity weil shortcut checks language first; words shared with English, such as hat, are not decisive German evidence. Focused tests, consumer typechecks, selected browser regressions and the isolated German 20.8.28-to-20.8.29 installer lifecycle passed. B03 and comprehensive acceptance remain incomplete, so the ticket stays implemented. The detector remains heuristic; neither all-grammar assessment nor validated language identification is claimed.
tasks.deliverable: Guarded language classification and task-specific normalisation.
acceptance: Known English/French/Spanish negatives do not default to German; ambiguous short text can abstain.
Valid German with few marker words is not falsely rejected.
German capitalization and relevant endings remain assessable; only declared harmless normalisation is allowed.

tasks.title: Separate practice completion from independent success
tasks.deliverable: Exposure-aware examples, hints, repairs and completion flags.
acceptance: Viewed model answers and copied repairs cannot qualify as independent retrieval.
Offline open work and nonempty rule explanations can be saved without assessed mastery.
Hide assessed solutions until deliberate reveal; preserve useful teaching examples on the teaching stage.

tasks.title: Remove conflicting verification paths
tasks.progressNote: Fixed the inspected English Automaticity caller boundary so app state and its evidence bundle retain the assessment verification result instead of forcing deterministic verification; the selected browser regression passed. Shared reducer consistency, actual elapsed-delay and novelty evidence, answer exposure, duplicate/re-recording handling and overturned-verdict propagation remain pending under E01/E02 and the remaining F04 work.
tasks.deliverable: A single assessment result supplies both application state and evidence.
acceptance: The same attempt cannot be unverified in one store and verified in another.
Transfer mode alone supplies no novelty; a due flag supplies no actual elapsed delay.
Repeated submission, re-recording and overturned verdicts produce consistent derived progress.

tasks.title: Define versioned construction, task and assessment contracts
tasks.deliverable: Shared schema version and typed English/German adapters.
acceptance: Include stable IDs, task/rubric versions, opportunities, exposure, assistance, first attempt, transfer condition and timing provenance.
Include assessment IDs, supersession/invalidation, original and edited transcript identities, and review provenance.
Validate pass, needs_repair, target_not_observed and not_assessed without model-defined mastery.

tasks.title: Implement idempotent evidence reduction
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic event reducer and modality-specific summaries.
acceptance: Deduplicate event IDs and include eligible failures in declared windows.
Invalidate superseded judgments and recompute repair/progress/scheduling inputs while retaining history.
Untested, missing audio and missing timing remain unknown or unassessed; never synthesize proof.

tasks.title: Migrate legacy and static-route state safely
tasks.deliverable: Versioned migration, aliases, export/restore and rollback.
acceptance: All original lesson associations, answers, dates, reviews and audio remain readable.
Repeated migration is idempotent; missing historical evidence remains marked insufficient.
Interrupted/corrupt migration restores the saved pre-migration state; language backups cannot cross-import.

tasks.title: Distribute shared code to every runtime
tasks.deliverable: Updated sync file list, schemas and static-browser entry bundle.
acceptance: Canonical source changes propagate to both package mirrors and relevant public bundles.
The sync --check fails on a deliberately stale or missing copy.
Identical Node and browser input produces the same assessment/evidence interpretation.

tasks.title: Define the grammar-construction inventory
tasks.deliverable: Stable language-specific construction IDs across all 21 strategy families.
acceptance: Specify form, meaning, use, contrasts, prerequisites and valid alternatives.
Separate hard prerequisites from instructional suggestions; reject prerequisite cycles.
Reviewer role/date and source mappings are recorded; model-authored drafts are not labelled human-reviewed.

tasks.title: Map every existing lesson and identify missing constructions
tasks.deliverable: English/German crosswalk and explicit missing-coverage backlog.
acceptance: Account for all 112 English and 144 German starting units, allowing verified inventory changes and additions.
Preserve old IDs/titles as aliases; support many-to-many mappings.
Check every family against reviewed references; equal level counts do not prove completeness.

tasks.title: Define appropriate task types and separate exposed material
tasks.deliverable: Typed task families and teaching/practice/calibration/final-test partition rules.
acceptance: Differentiate comprehension, recall, correction, transformation, constrained/free production and interaction.
Acceptable transformations preserve meaning and grammatical possibility.
Track template/scenario families and exposure; final evaluation material cannot enter generated practice.

tasks.title: Build an executable coverage gate
tasks.deliverable: Generated coverage matrix and actionable missing-cell report.
acceptance: Track required construction x mode x learning-stage x evaluator coverage with evidence references.
N/A needs a linguistic reason; unavailable implementation or evaluator is a gap, not N/A.
Retain original lessons as a migration minimum and replace obsolete exact exercise-count assertions.

tasks.title: Implement representative construction validators and tasks
tasks.deliverable: Reviewed bilingual packs for inflection, valency, temporal meaning, clause order, modality/voice and discourse.
acceptance: Correct alternatives pass; wrong-role keywords and grammatical irrelevant text do not.
Unsupported judgments abstain or enter the explicit human-review path.
Each pack covers retrieval, applicable variation, speaking, writing, repair and transfer.

tasks.title: Make audio and response timing trustworthy
tasks.deliverable: Playable audio, transcript provenance and valid response-timing capture.
acceptance: Typed or edited transcripts cannot establish original spoken success.
Silence, corrupt audio and uncertain ASR leave affected dimensions unassessed; network time is excluded.
Untimed/accessibility modes retain accuracy evidence without fluency claims; no universal eight-second pass gate.

tasks.title: Integrate actual Daily and Grammar routes
tasks.deliverable: Shared assessment/evidence on /daily, /grammar, /heute and /grammatik.
acceptance: Start, respond, reveal a hint, repair, navigate back and reload without losing the draft or evidence.
Generated catalogs match their canonical source and contain new task metadata.
Static fallback code cannot bypass or disagree with the common contract.

tasks.title: Integrate Studio, Errors, Reviews, Progress and teacher review
tasks.deliverable: All remaining learning surfaces read and write the same evidence.
acceptance: Both static and React routes agree on the same attempt and next repair.
Human review can accept a valid alternative, overturn a verdict and recompute progress.
Delayed-review eligibility requires elapsed time and unexposed task/context evidence.

tasks.title: Verify the representative end-to-end learning cycle
tasks.deliverable: Browser receipts for both languages and both productive modes.
acceptance: Demonstrate production -> feedback -> learner repair -> new-context transfer -> later review.
Use a test clock for scheduling logic but do not claim a simulated delay proves learning.
Record this milestone as architecture verified, full curriculum incomplete.

tasks.title: Implement transparent personal task selection
tasks.deliverable: Rule-based selection using eligible evidence, prerequisites, reviews and coverage.
acceptance: Prioritise consequential repair and due recall without monopolising the queue.
Reduce new work when reviews accumulate; keep language histories separate.
Record a learner override and explain the selected task in plain language.

tasks.title: Deliver one clear daily card with reliable resume
tasks.deliverable: Daily card with target, reason, action, session budget and next step.
acceptance: Keyboard/touch users can start and finish the next action without visiting technical settings.
Back/Forward, refresh, interruptions and reopening retain the chosen task and draft.
One or two daily focuses do not hide or cap the full grammar curriculum.

tasks.title: Replace unsupported progress and CEFR claims
tasks.deliverable: Dated construction-by-mode progress with counts and uncertainty.
acceptance: Show support use, independent accuracy, transfer, retention and timing separately.
A grammar completion total never generates a global CEFR certificate.
Old evidence remains visible with its limitations; no silent deletion or invented upgrade.

tasks.title: Verify offline recovery, consent and accessibility
tasks.deliverable: Verified recoverable offline and accessible learning flow.
acceptance: Mic refusal, provider failure and storage quota errors preserve the attempt and explain the next action.
Cloud assessment consent, stored history and training reuse are separate; no raw answers/audio enter aggregate analytics.
Check keyboard, mobile/tablet reflow, reading order, local Persian RTL guidance and untimed mode; report any unavailable screen-reader/device test.

tasks.title: Create reviewed English and German assessment benchmarks
tasks.deliverable: Versioned grammar-specific development, calibration and untouched final-test manifests, starting with the representative pilot scope and expanding to all families.
acceptance: Review correct alternatives, errors, ambiguity, irrelevance and ASR corruption for each released scope; initial pilot scope can close independently of the full 21-family expansion.
Separate sources/learners/template families where applicable; adjudicate consequential disagreement.
Record licensing and human review; predeclare error limits and coverage requirements before final testing.
Every expansion records construction IDs, content versions and benchmark version; full-scope benchmark coverage must be refreshed before W05.

tasks.title: Compare rules, LanguageTool and pretrained candidates
tasks.deliverable: Scope-versioned task comparison of the baseline, feasible local candidate and optional hosted candidate.
acceptance: Report false corrections, missed errors, meaning preservation, target detection, abstention, latency and operating cost per language/family.
Choose thresholds on calibration data; freeze them before final tests.
Existing CEFR text classifiers and external threshold searches are not treated as validated grammar judges.
Report evaluated construction IDs and content/benchmark versions; repeat evaluation for new or materially changed families before their approval.

tasks.title: Decide which assessment functions are supported
tasks.deliverable: Versioned deployment decision and supported-family/mode matrix for the currently evaluated release scope.
acceptance: A rejected candidate leaves the baseline operational and records the reason.
Every required cell in the evaluated scope names an available automatic or human assessment path; later families cannot inherit an earlier scope's approval.
No supported label relies on model-generated benchmark answers that the same model self-certified.
Initial scope approval can support the pilot; full-scope approval with current M01/M02 evidence is required at W05.

tasks.title: Integrate a qualified Transformer through the shared contract
tasks.deliverable: Optional model adapter with version pinning, structured outputs and fallback.
acceptance: Model proposals cannot directly mutate mastery or scheduling.
Validate output structure and evidence spans; preserve minimal correction separately from stylistic rewriting.
Provider unavailable/changed model triggers unassessed or validated fallback; rerun relevant benchmarks after changes.
tasks.condition: A candidate passes M03 and its deployment is selected; if selected, required before model-assisted release.

tasks.title: Complete foundation and reference families
tasks.deliverable: Both languages complete families G01,G02,G03,G04,G05,G13.
acceptance: Apply the common family completion checklist at every relevant level.
Preserve prior lesson identities; add reviewed omitted constructions.
Generate catalog parity and browser evidence for completed cells.

tasks.title: Complete temporal and verb-system families
tasks.deliverable: Both languages complete families G06,G07,G08,G09,G10.
acceptance: Review valency, auxiliaries, aspect/time meaning, modal meaning and lawful transformations.
Respect cross-family prerequisites without forcing every learner through a linear wave order.
Apply the common family completion checklist.

tasks.title: Complete complex proposition families
tasks.deliverable: Both languages complete families G11,G12,G14,G15,G16.
acceptance: Review negation scope, questions, voice, role assignment, linking, relative reference and hypothetical meaning.
Validate required foundation/verb subskills before integrated task release.
Apply the common family completion checklist.

tasks.title: Complete discourse, advanced integration and orthography
tasks.deliverable: Both languages complete families G17,G18,G19,G20,G21.
acceptance: Assess reported meaning, information structure, cohesion and register in suitable discourse tasks.
Apply orthography from the first relevant task; this wave does not postpone capitalization correctness.
Apply the common family completion checklist; written-only cells need justified N/A for speech.

tasks.title: Close the full-curriculum coverage gate
tasks.deliverable: Signed-off coverage report for every in-scope construction in both languages.
acceptance: All initial lessons mapped and every reviewed addition included; zero unexplained required missing cells.
Each assessed cell has reviewed tasks, valid alternatives, evaluator availability, route evidence and generated-content parity.
Split the report into automatic, human-reviewed and unassessed coverage; unassessed required cells prevent full assessed-coverage completion.
A representative slice or count parity cannot close this task.
Require refreshed full-scope M01-M03 evidence matching the final construction/content versions, not only a previously completed representative benchmark.

tasks.title: Prepare personal baseline and evaluation protocol
tasks.deliverable: Dated unaided speaking/writing baseline and matched new follow-up prompts.
acceptance: Keep English and German separate; do not assign an unvalidated overall CEFR level.
Collect comparable baseline samples before the target practice intervention and log other tutoring/practice.
Choose outcomes and eligibility windows in advance; never expose final probes during practice.

tasks.title: Run daily learning on the verified pilot release
tasks.deliverable: Prospective dated practice and assistance evidence on reviewed target packs.
acceptance: Save learner-authored responses/audio only under the chosen storage/consent settings.
No scripted browser session substitutes for learner participation.
Pilot can start before W05; accurately label the available curriculum scope.

tasks.title: Measure transfer and delayed retention
tasks.deliverable: Language/mode-specific outcome report with dated independent probes.
acceptance: Measure unfamiliar-context performance and actual 24-hour/7-day delays, with a later 30-day check where applicable.
Report opportunity and attempt denominators, assistance, errors, valid timing and uncertainty.
Separate workflow completion, technical success, personal improvement trend and causal claims; no results without real samples.

tasks.title: Make prospective FSRS history evidence-eligible
tasks.deliverable: Validated review-event mapping with repeated-item memory separate from transfer.
acceptance: Only eligible timestamped review outcomes feed the experiment.
Do not invent ratings or reconstruct missing history from aggregate progress.
FSRS remains shadow-only and changing due dates stays disabled.

tasks.title: Qualify FSRS in shadow, then compare candidate review dates
tasks.deliverable: Two-stage evaluation: shadow qualification followed, if justified, by a bounded learner comparison of actual candidate dates and an activation decision.
acceptance: Stage A uses eligible shadow data to assess recall calibration and simulated workload only; it cannot establish the learning effect of changed intervals.

Stage B requires a predeclared comparison, learner opt-in, qualified eligible targets, delivered-code verification under R01, rollback controls and actual candidate due dates for the bounded pilot; broad activation remains disabled.
Compare real delayed accuracy and workload with uncertainty, missing follow-ups and intervening practice; insufficient evidence leads to deferral.
Define benefit/non-inferiority criteria before Stage B; prediction accuracy alone cannot certify spontaneous grammar competence.

tasks.title: Activate a qualified scheduler reversibly
tasks.deliverable: Optional staged scheduler activation with replayable state and rollback.
acceptance: Activate only after benefit/non-inferiority criteria are met.
Retain baseline schedule snapshot and preserve due-review obligations and learner overrides.
Run the release checklist for this increment as well.
tasks.condition: S02 supplies sufficient favourable evidence; otherwise leave shadow-only.

tasks.title: Prepare the repeatable release and preservation checklist
tasks.progressNote: Both isolated lifecycles passed previous-version install, upgrade, startup, update, payload repair and uninstall: English 27.3.22-to-27.3.23 and German 20.8.28-to-20.8.29. Their reports retain artifact hashes and synthetic-marker preservation limits. All eight selected browser regressions and 10 restored-source HTTP probes passed. Aggregate full-repository gates, normal-profile coverage and full export/restore/audio preservation remain incomplete under B01/B02 and R01; isolated lifecycle success is not full release qualification.
tasks.deliverable: Exact command map, isolated lifecycle fixture and evidence receipt template.
acceptance: Identify packaging metadata and payload inputs for both apps.
Use isolated install/data roots; include actual old-version to new-version migration, not only reinstalling one version.
Record source revision plus worktree diff, app version, artifact hashes, browser routes and preserved-data comparisons.

tasks.title: Deliver and verify the first learning-loop release
tasks.deliverable: Exact English/German pilot installers and route/preservation receipts.
acceptance: Run focused regressions, required app checks, builds and actual-route browser journeys.
Rebuild Install/Update/Repair payloads; verify isolated install/start/update/repair/export/restore with playable audio.
Record only measured outcomes; blocked policy/signing/device gates remain explicit and cannot become success.
If Transformer assistance is included, verify M04 and current scope-matched M01-M03 approval before delivery.

conditionalDependencies.when: The pilot release includes a selected Transformer adapter.

tasks.title: Deliver the full-curriculum release
tasks.deliverable: Exact release versions with complete coverage and lifecycle evidence.
acceptance: Repeat the release checklist for final content and shared-bundle changes.
Include M04 verification if a Transformer was selected; no old installer payload may omit the new schema/content.
Report technical release, curriculum coverage and learner-effectiveness status separately.

conditionalDependencies.when: A Transformer adapter is selected for this release.

tasks.title: Assess readiness for a contextual-bandit experiment
tasks.deliverable: Conditional research decision with adequate-data and evaluation-design assessment.
acceptance: Require trustworthy delayed reward data, eligible action choices and a justified sample/uncertainty plan.
Do not assume one learner can supply enough data; default to keeping the useful rule-based policy.
This decision does not delay the core full-curriculum release.
tasks.condition: Only after measured learning and scheduling evidence justify considering RL.

tasks.title: Compare a bounded practice-selection policy
tasks.deliverable: Optional contextual-bandit experiment with immutable final test and fallback.
acceptance: Log context, chosen action, probability, policy version and linked delayed outcome.
Keep policy-development probes separate from final evaluation; do not reward clicks, copied answers or speed alone.
Constrain exploration to pedagogically eligible options and apply preregistered benefit/non-inferiority criteria.
tasks.condition: X01 finds sufficient data and a sound design; learner participation is available.

tasks.title: Decide whether sequential RL adds value
tasks.deliverable: Optional evidence-based decision, including an explicit defer outcome.
acceptance: Require measurable benefit beyond the rule policy/bandit and sufficient longitudinal evidence.
Simulator results do not count as learner gains.
No training-from-scratch or full-RL project starts merely to satisfy a technology preference.
tasks.condition: A completed X02 experiment exposes a justified sequential decision problem.
